rollforward.notes: SERT audited Distribution Statement (Year ended 31 December 2025), page marker <!-- PAGE 169 --> (TOC lists p167; marker ±few). A(39,886) + B(74,787) - P(76,431) = 38,242 = E exactly (tol ~1000). P = cash 'Distributions declared during the year' 76,431 = Note B period-mixed tranches: 7.056c per Unit for 1 Jul-31 Dec 2024 (€39,683k) + 6.553c per Stapled Security for 1 Jan-30 Jun 2025 (€36,748k) = 13.609c paid, crossing fiscal years. distribution_paid_declared recorded as DPS-for-year 13.390 EUR cents/security (declared basis, distinct from the 13.609c actually paid); no monetary FY2025-declared total is disclosed as a line in the Distribution Statement. txns.verbatim: On 11 November 2025, Stoneweg European REIT Group completed the divestment of its entire Slovakia portfolio via the sale of 100% of its shares held in five Slovakian property companies ("Slovakia Group") (Note 16) for total consideration of €70.0 million for the net equity of the shares of the five subsidiaries, representing a 3.5% premium to the latest net asset value. (Note 5(a), p201). Footnote 9 p43: valuation €72.4m as at 30 Jun 2025; final consideration €70.0m – €2.3m or 3.5% premium to net equity value €67.7m.
